entries.name: Dick Gregory

expected_cases.convicted: Arrested and jailed for illegal net fishing during a treaty-rights 'fish-in'
expected_cases.sentence: Initial detention for a Nisqually treaty-rights fish-in: arrested February 16, 1966 and released on bail February 17. The Civil Liberties Docket describes two days in jail, counting calendar dates. Sentenced January 12, 1967; the later 1968 sentence service was separate from this pretrial detention.

case.charges: Illegal net fishing: later sentence service following the 1966 Nisqually fish-in
case.sentence: Later service of the fish-in sentence, after appeals. Began in June 1968; sources disagree between June 6 and June 7, so only the month is recorded. Released July 16, 1968 as a trustee at large to serve the remainder outside jail. This endpoint is release from physical confinement, not completion of the 90-day sentence. His hospital stay during the fast remained guarded custody. The February 1966 pretrial detention is recorded separately.

entries.rationale: HistoryLink dates physical release July16; contemporary Helix volume4 issue2 p21 confirms trustee-at-large release on Tuesday and guarded hospital custody. June admission day conflicts, so retain month precision and do not calculate an exact total or count the full imposed90days.
